items.description: Designated S Kerby Joseph to return from the physically unable to perform list.
Signed TEs Devin Culp and Bryson Nesbit to the practice squad. Placed WR Michael Briscoe on practice squad injured reserve.
Signed OL Kingsley Eguakun from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed WR Zay Jones to the practice squad.

Signed WR Van Jefferson from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed OLB Kyle Kennard to the practice squad. Placed WR Terry McLaurin on injured reserve. Designated DT Jer'Zhan Newton to return from injured reserve.
Signed OLB Andre Jones Jr. and CB A.J. Woods to the practice squad. Released CB Anthony Kendall and DL Austin Johnson from the practice squad.
Signed RB Zavier Scott from the practice squad to the active roster. Released DB Nick McCloud.

Signed TE Cam Grandy from Minnesota's practice squad to the active roster. Signed TE Caden Prieskorn to the practice squad. Placed TE Erick All Jr. on injured reserve and TE Josh Kattus on practice squad injured reserve.
Signed DE Nadame Tucker to the practice squad. Released RB Jaret Patterson and S John Saunders from the practice squad.
Waived RB Emari Demercado and TE D.J. Rogers.
Signed WR Eli Pancol to the practice squad. Released DB Ugochukwu Amadi from the practice squad.
Signed DT Taki Taimani to the practice squad. Released WR Lawrence Keys from the practice squad.
Acquired a 2027 third-round draft pick and a 2028 fifth-round draft pick from Seattle Seahawks for G Quenton Nelson.
Reinstated WR Dont'e Thornton from injured reserve. Waived DT Jonah Laulu. Released WR Jamari Thrash from the practice squad.
Signed LB Jon Rhattigan to the practice squad. Released DB Nyzier Fourqurean and LB Eli Neal from the practice squad.
Signed T Alan Herron to the practice squad. Released WR Kyrese Rowan from the practice squad.

Signed RB Gregory Desrosiers from the Los Angeles Chargers' practice squad to the active roster. Signed DE Dean Lowry to the practice squad. Placed RB Tyrone Tracy on injured reserve. Released WR Jason Brownlee from the practice squad.
Signed DL Amari McNeill to the practice squad.
Released DB Dean Clark and OT Xavier Truss from the practice squad. Waived RB Carson Steele from injured reserve with an injury settlement.

Signed WR Zay Jones to a contract. Re-signed OL Austin Deculus and S Wydett Williams Jr. to the practice squad. Released S Jerrick Reed II from the practice squad. Placed WR Jalen Brooks on injured reserve. Waived TE Jameson Geers from injured reserve.
Signed WR Tejhaun Palmer to the practice squad.
Acquired DT DeForest Buckner from Indianapolis for a 2027 fourth-round draft pick. Signed DT Kevin Givens to the practice squad. Released WR Malik Turner from the practice squad.

Acquired G Quenton Nelson from Indianapolis for a 2027 third-round draft pick and a 2028 fifth-round draft pick. Signed WRs Montorie Foster Jr. and Malick Meiga to the practice squad. Released FB Jackson Acker, TE Josiah Deguara and LB Josh Ross from the practice squad. Waived G Christian Haynes.
Signed RB Barika Kpeenu to the practice squad. Released QB Brett Rypien from the practice squad.
Signed LB Nick Hampton from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed LB Ja'Markis Weston to the practice squad. Placed T Taylor Moton on injured reserve.
Signed G Michael Jordan to the practice squad. Released RB Jonathan Ward from the practice squad.
